name: Standing Calf Raise on the Bench Press Machine
how_to:
1. Setup: Step onto the machine’s platform with the balls of your feet firmly on the edge and your heels hanging off.
2. Position: Stand upright and grip the side handles for balance and stability.
3. Starting Position: Keep your core engaged, back straight, and legs nearly straight (but not locked out).
4. Raise Your Heels: Press through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible. Focus on contracting your calves at the top.
5. Pause and Squeeze: Hold the top position for 1–2 seconds to maximize muscle engagement.
6. Lower Under Control: Slowly lower your heels below the level of the platform for a full stretch before repeating.
